description: A consumer submits a structured execution request and receives an accepted outcome with a verifiable result reference. Field values below are placeholders for illustration only.

input.note: Structured business input defined by the agreed contract for this operation. Shape is operation-specific and out of scope for this example.

notes: outcome is one of: accepted | denied. A denied outcome follows the error-denial contract.
result_ref is an opaque, verifiable reference to the outcome; it is retrieved via the status-result contract.
Acceptance of a request does not by itself imply execution authority or completion.
